title: Model
description: A model and where it runs: on this machine, or at a hosted provider. Name it after the model itself. There is no implicit default and no automatic fallback.

name.description: The model's own id, as agents list it in inference.models, e.g. qwen2.5-1.5b-q4 or claude-sonnet-5-5.

provider.description: Local models run on a server on this machine with no internet. Hosted models send prompts off the machine.

model.description: Model path (local) or the provider's model id (hosted).

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint of the local server, e.g. http://inference-cpu:8080/v1 or Ollama at http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1.

base_url.description: https base URL of the provider's API.

credential.description: Name of a vault entry (secrets/). Never paste the key itself.

egress_host.description: Host added to the gateway egress allowlist (must match base_url).

daily_spend_cap_usd.description: Required for hosted models so spend is always bounded.

max_concurrency.description: How many requests the gateway sends this model at once. Others wait in the gateway's queue.

allowed_agents.description: Restrict which agents may use this model. Recommended for hosted models.

fallback.description: Optional, explicit. Models to try, in order, if this one is down. Empty by default. A hosted model here means data leaves the machine.
